title: DerivedUnit
statement: For an exact additive functor U:A→B between abelian categories with chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], objects F in B and H in A and a morphism η:F→U(H), define DerivedUnit(U,F,H,η) to say that composition with single(η) followed by the inverse exact-functor single comparison induces a bijection Hom(single H,K)→Hom(single F,DU(K)) for every unbounded complex K.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: This is the Hom universal property of the specified scalar-extension unit. The single comparison identifies single(UH) with DU(single H), so the displayed composition is defined without constructing or choosing a left adjoint.

def DerivedUnit
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [Category.{vA} A] [Category.{vB} B]
    [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} B]
    (U : A ⥤ B) [U.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    (F : B) (H : A) (η : F ⟶ U.obj H) : Prop
